name: webobsidian
description: WebObsidian — a personal desktop and Android Markdown application

scripts.build: npm run build:core && npm --workspace web run build && npm --workspace server run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:core && npm --workspace server run typecheck && npm --workspace web run typecheck
scripts.desktop: npm run build && npm --workspace desktop run dev
scripts.desktop:dist: npm run build && npm --workspace desktop run dist
scripts.desktop:publish: npm run build && npm --workspace desktop run dist:publish
scripts.build:core: npm --workspace @webobsidian/search-core run build && npm --workspace @webobsidian/markdown-core run build
